raw.hi: 25. निकट दृष्टि दोष को निम्नलिखित में किस लेंस के द्वारा हटाया जाता है ? raw.en: 25. Which of the following lenses is used to remove short sightedness ? (A) Cylindrical (B) Convex (C) Concave (D) Bifocal | 26. Most of the refraction of the light rays entering the eye occurs at (A) Interface of eye lens (B) Interface of aqueous humour (C) Outer surface of cornea (D) None of these | 27. Which of the following is the unit of power of lens ? (A) dioptre (B) watt (C) erg (D) joule

notes: Q25-27, all Physics (eye/lens topics). Answer key: Q25=(C) Concave, Q26=(C) Outer surface of cornea, Q27=(A) dioptre. No pen marks visible.
